meta.title: Fix Invoice Preview Re-rendering Issue
meta.body_summary: Fix excessive re-rendering of the invoice preview component when accordion sections open/close by isolating the PDF preview from React's rendering lifecycle using global state and DOM manipulation.

perf_labels.notes: Devin attempted to fix React re-rendering via DOM isolation; Vercel deploy failed and no human review occurred; PR manually closed by maintainer.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 364 changed lines across 8 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, primarily adding a new DOM-isolated preview component (163 lines) and wiring it into the page. As a targeted performance fix, it was closed—not merged—likely due to Vercel deployment failure and absence of maintainer review.

review_details.concern_detail: Vercel bot reported deployment failure; no human review feedback provided in the dataset.
review_details.performance_claim: Preventing excessive re-renders of the invoice preview caused by accordion toggles by isolating the PDF preview from React rendering lifecycle using global state and DOM manipulation.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: excessive_re_render (prior behavior; not in taxonomy enum)
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed by maintainer (legions-developer) after Vercel deployment failed and no review or fix-in-PR cycle; no explicit rejection comment.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Complex React rendering optimization requiring bypassing React's lifecycle with global state and DOM manipulation; deployment issue and lack of maintainer engagement led to closure without merge.

detection_detail.ci_auto: Vercel build/deploy failed, indicated by bot comment.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes console log evidence of reduced renders (count 0), but no benchmark or before/after performance metrics; deployment failure prevents verification.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without further fix attempts after Vercel deploy failure.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced a new component InvoicePreviewIsolated that uses window state and event listeners to update PDF preview via DOM manipulation, bypassing React re-renders; updated page.tsx to use it and added test-isolated.js for debugging; also made PostHog env vars optional to fix deployment.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Additional commits fixed Vercel deployment by making PostHog env vars optional and adding error handling.
change_trajectory: Second commit: wrapper component with React.memo and custom comparison.
Third commit: DOM isolation approach with window state and new component.
Later commits: fix Vercel build by making env vars optional, conditional PostHog provider, error handling.
